articles.title: Bohl, Opp named to Division B All-State volleyball roster
articles.summary: Nov. 27—JAMESTOWN — Violet Bohl capped off her prep volleyball career as a Class B First-Team, All-Stater. Bohl, a senior for the Medina/Pingree-Buchanan volleyball team, was named to the Class B Volleyball First-Team, All-State team on Wednesday evening.
